path.description: Existing source file path supported by an LSP server. This path is also used to infer the workspace root. Absolute paths need no `workdir`; a relative path requires one.

workdir.description: Optional absolute directory on the target daemon's file system, used only to resolve a relative `path`. Required when `path` is relative; never inherited from a previous call, a session default, or the environment root. Provide an expanded absolute path (no '~', no environment variable placeholders); Windows targets use a drive-rooted or UNC path.

line.description: 1-based line number for the target position.

character.description: 0-based character offset at the target position. Defaults to 0.
